reference.pathophysiology: Emetogenic signals converge on the medullary vomiting network from blood borne trigger zone detection, vestibular motion mismatch, vagal gut serotonin release and cortical conditioning. Receptor specific blockade interrupts single inputs, so combination regimens covering serotonin, substance P and dopamine pathways outperform monotherapy in chemotherapy, while vestibular vomiting ignores serotonin blockade entirely.
